name: pixelproof
description: Pixel-exact UI from design references, plus design audits and roasts: an agent skill that measures screenshots, slices them into HTML+CSS, implements them with approval gates, and checks consistency.
author: Kevin Christian (Arklify)

scripts.test: node cli/pixelproof.mjs --help && python3 -c "import ast,glob;[ast.parse(open(f).read()) for f in glob.glob('skills/pixelproof/scripts/*.py')]" && node --check skills/pixelproof/scripts/check_parity.mjs && node --check skills/pixelproof/scripts/check_tokens.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('skills/pixelproof/SKILL.md','utf8');for(const m of s.matchAll(/commands\/([a-z]+)\.md/g)){if(!fs.existsSync('skills/pixelproof/commands/'+m[1]+'.md'))throw new Error('missing command file '+m[1])}"
